detailed_descriptions.en: My Fire Is Bigger Than Yours is a physics-based incremental game about growing a tiny fire until its bigger than the sun. It is a short, escalating experience about discovering synergies, experimenting with builds, and creating chaotic chain reactions. Grow The Fire Throw objects into the fire and keep it alive as the sun tries to drown it out Really, Grow Adapt your strategy across 3 phases as your fire grows from a tiny campfire to a celestial force. Start your own cult to feed the flames, then expand your operation to the Moon. Upgrade Discover and unlock 200+ upgrades to create unique builds that change how your fire grows, spreads, and reacts. Strategize Specialize in one flammable type, discover cascading reactions, or craft the perfect automated layout. However you choose to grow, the Sun must be defeated.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
My Fire Is Bigger Than Yours is a physics-based incremental game about growing a tiny fire until its bigger than the sun. It is a short, escalating experience about discovering synergies, experimenting with builds, and creating chaotic chain reactions.

Grow The Fire

Throw objects into the fire and keep it alive as the sun tries to drown it out

Really, Grow

Adapt your strategy across 3 phases as your fire grows from a tiny campfire to a celestial force. Start your own cult to feed the flames, then expand your operation to the Moon.

Upgrade

Discover and unlock 200+ upgrades to create unique builds that change how your fire grows, spreads, and reacts.

Strategize

Specialize in one flammable type, discover cascading reactions, or craft the perfect automated layout.

However you choose to grow, the Sun must be defeated.
